observed_parent_failure: H001 exited recovered pullbacks after a median few minutes at gross moves too small to cover a modeled 0.1% fee on both entry and exit.
single_controlled_change: Keep H001 entries and indicators unchanged; permit exit signals only above 0.25% gross profit, use a fee-aware ROI floor, and tighten the catastrophic stop from 1.8% to 1.2%.
expected_effect: Remove structurally fee-negative micro exits without using outcome timestamps or pair-specific rules.
falsification_criteria: training net profit is non-positive or profit factor is <= 1
validation net profit is non-positive or profit factor is <= 1
one- or two-candle entry delay makes validation expectancy non-positive
trade count falls below 10 per day or exceeds 20 per day in the combined development windows
decision_rule: Run training first. Open validation only if all training gates pass. Keep frozen OOS sealed until all pre-OOS tests pass.
